purpose: Reference-conditioned Stegosaurus expansion after P11 confirmed prompt-only retries can improve bony plate material but still invent tail-parallel lower points, straight tail-spear extensions, or five-spike/radial thagomizers; next route should use tail-local ControlNet/inpaint before broader color polish.

workflowNotes: Use the controlReference as line/depth/ControlNet structure guidance, not as direct training art.
P9 v93-v96 showed prompt-only retries are not enough: use a tail-local mask/inpaint or ControlNet guide that ends the tail at a rounded spike base.
The two lower thagomizer spikes must still angle upward relative to the ground/horizon, not sideways along the tail shaft.
P10 v97-v99 showed that whole-body prompting still leaves lower spikes tail-parallel or overcorrects into five/radial spikes; do not promote these as positives.
P11 v100-v102 improved rough pale-bone/rust plate material, especially v100, but still failed the strict tail gate through five/radial count, straight tail-spear, or tail-parallel lower-point drift.
Reject outputs if any thagomizer spike or tail-point lies parallel to the ground or horizon.
Reject outputs if the thagomizer reads as three spikes plus a side nub, five-plus spikes, a radial starburst, or a continued pointed tail.
Reject outputs if the plate row becomes a single connected sail, a row of identical triangular teeth, or same-color leather-like skin flaps.
